widgets_values:
Square 1:1 street-culture poster, shot on film, hard afternoon sun, saturated colour-block palette of cobalt blue, orange, green and cream.

BACKGROUND — a flat saturated cobalt blue sky fills the whole frame, with three large flat green organic blobs drifting behind the subject (one at the top right, one at the middle left, one at the bottom left) and two small yellow arrow marks, all clean flat vector shapes.

GIANT TYPE — behind the subject, cropped by the top edge and by both side edges, a giant word in fat orange bubble lettering with a soft drop shadow: first line the two characters "H3" filling most of the upper half, and below it the same lettering, one step smaller, the word "IMAGE".

SUBJECT — a young person sitting on a yellow fire hydrant in the lower centre, legs hanging down on both sides, relaxed: loose green knit sweater with the collar showing, wide cobalt blue trousers, white socks, cream suede sneakers, a small yellow cap. One hand rests under the chin, the other holds a compact rangefinder camera in their lap. Warm skin tones, crisp sunlight, a hard shadow of the hydrant on the ground, subtle grain.

ANNOTATION TYPE — small, precise, all upper and lower case grotesque, English only:
lower left, three short white lines: "The title does not matter. Pixels do."
below it, bold yellow caps: "TEXT TO IMAGE · IMAGE EDIT".
right side, four small white lines stacked: "SIX SAMPLING STEPS", "NO CFG", "SIXTEEN REFERENCES", "4096 x 4096".
bottom left corner, small white: "MINIMAX H3 IMAGE".

No Chinese characters anywhere, no QR code, no watermark, no logos on clothing, no extra lettering beyond the listed strings.
